sahneler.metin: An Italian steamer full of emigrants ran onto a reef off Spain.
It struck at full speed, and at least two hundred people were killed.
It was bound for South America.
Its course ran too close to the coast.
It hit a reef off Hormigas Island.
An eyewitness said it was taking a dangerous course.
Panic broke out, and lifeboats were swamped.
The disaster shook emigrant communities in Italy.
